limitations: Instrumented operation durations are elapsed spans including browser, queueing and scheduling, not CPU attribution.
Cgroup cpu.stat covers owner interval; throttled_usec is a scheduler counter, not directly subtractable wall-time savings.

sourceBinding.scope: Defer the original VA driver/profile singleton initialization until its first ordinary consumer. Preserve DRM preparation, stub loading, original hardware results and all media consumer paths. Feature defaults off and requires no-sandbox. Same-binary feature off/on comparison.
functionalGate: software video pixels and ended state
fresh-context media isolation and idle CPU
native trace proves no profile construction before media and original initialization on demand
sourceBinding.advancement: At least 20% lower complete time in both orders for four-worker applications, no semantic failures. Final 2x acceptance remains separate.

sourceReview.scope: Read-only source review of static initialization, cached lock policy, copied workarounds, disabled path and GPU child no-sandbox propagation

retainedFailures: Initial media marker returned unsupported PerformanceMark through evaluation codec; corrected to return undefined, media assertions unchanged.
Diagnostic native ANGLE OpenGL control failed on the original eager baseline GPU initialization; candidate not run under that rejected policy.
Default, decoder-feature and encoder-feature queries on this host never reached deferred hardware initialization. Equal answers and software playback do not prove hardware playback preservation.

decision.threshold: At least20% lower complete time in both orders for both four-worker applications; no more than5% one-worker regression
decision.next: Keep as an experimental composition candidate; validate first-use hardware initialization on a reachable hardware/native path and address remaining complete-suite time before the final matrix.

limitations: Two applications and two opposite-order blocks; not the final nine-scenario eight-pair confidence gate.
All tested hardware decoder answers were false. Native traces prove eager omission, not successful deferred hardware initialization.
AcceleratedVideoEncoder/driver-blocklist diagnostic controls are separate from default-policy performance captures.
Feature requires --no-sandbox; sandboxed operation remains eager.
First hardware-use latency and watchdog behavior remain open.
Instrumented request spans include waiting and scheduling; cgroup throttled time is not subtractable wall savings.
No release or public default profile adoption.
